condition: Atrial fibrillation found at pre-operative assessment
permutationLabel: Asymptomatic, found at pre-op assessment, elderly
summary: 81-year-old woman at pre-operative assessment for elective inguinal hernia repair: asymptomatic irregular pulse 92, previous TIA, hypertension, not anticoagulated. CHA2DS2-VA 5.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Pre-operative assessment for groin hernia repair
inputs.hpi: Listed for elective open repair of a left inguinal hernia. No palpitations, chest pain or breathlessness. Pre-op nurse found an irregular pulse. TIA in 2019 treated with clopidogrel. Hypertension.

exam.cardiovascular: Pulse 92 irregularly irregular, BP 138/80, heart sounds normal.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Atrial fibrillation, newly detected (asymptomatic)
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Newly detected asymptomatic atrial fibrillation at pre-op assessment, rate 92, CHA2DS2-VA 5 (age >=75, TIA, hypertension) - ECG confirmation, anticoagulation discussion, defer elective hernia repair pending cardiology/GP plan.

mustNotMiss.note: The hernia is the referral diagnosis; this checks whether the new AF is surfaced anywhere.
mustNotMiss.knownGapNote: Web run 2026-09-25: not in top 3 of web.pane: 1. Acute Cholecystitis | 2. Acute Diverticulitis | 3. GORD / Reflux Oesophagitis. PANE has no atrial fibrillation (or any arrhythmia) node.
mustNotMiss.proposedFix: lib/pane-engine: add an atrial fibrillation node (palpitations, irregular pulse, dyspnoea, age/hypertension modifiers) with an AF-CARE protocol (ECG confirmation, rate control, CHA2DS2-VA/DOAC, TFT) and map I48.

emergencyLevel.note: Asymptomatic, rate-controlled AF is not an emergency.

guideline.name: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation
guideline.section: AF-CARE: 12-lead ECG to confirm AF; emergency electrical cardioversion for haemodynamic instability; rate control (beta-blocker, diltiazem/verapamil, digoxin); stroke risk with CHA2DS2-VA - oral anticoagulation recommended for score >=2 and considered for 1; DOAC preferred over VKA; look for precipitants (thyroid function, infection)
guideline.citation: Van Gelder IC, Rienstra M, Bunting KV, et al. 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation developed in collaboration with EACTS. Eur Heart J. 2024;45:3314-3414.

rationale: Surgical-clinic permutation: AF discovered incidentally before elective surgery. Checks that an irregular pulse on examination surfaces the stroke-risk decision, without over-triaging to emergency.
